adult-bone-marrow-transplantation.title: Adult Bone Marrow Transplantation
adult-bone-marrow-transplantation.lead: Bone marrow (stem cell) transplantation is a complex, multi-stage treatment that calls for close teamwork between laboratories, clinical units and nursing staff. The transplant clinic at our partner hospital brings these stages together under one roof, from diagnostic work-up and treatment planning to follow-up after discharge. MedLuxLife helps adult patients and their families prepare medical records, arrange evaluation and stay well informed throughout a lengthy treatment journey.
cards: Transplant outpatient clinic

Coordinates assessment, decision-making, treatment and follow-up for patients who are being considered for, or are undergoing, a transplant, reviewing previous treatment, imaging, pathology and laboratory findings together.
Apheresis unit
Collects stem cells from the blood as part of the transplant process.
Stem cell freezing and processing
Processes stem cells and stores them cryogenically in nitrogen tanks, with separate quarantine and main storage, using an automated freezing system.
Flow cytometry laboratory
Analyses blood and marrow cells to support diagnosis, treatment planning and assessment of the response to treatment.
HLA tissue typing laboratory
Performs tissue typing used to assess compatibility between patient and donor.
Genetic diagnostic support
Works alongside a genetic diagnosis centre so that genetic findings can inform diagnosis and treatment decisions.
Protected transplant unit
Treatment takes place in single rooms within a dedicated unit with HEPA air filtration throughout, controlled disinfection on entry and beds that can be converted for emergency care.
Comfort and wellbeing
Rooms are designed with views and patient comfort in mind to support psychological wellbeing during a long hospital stay.
Follow-up before and after transplant
Patients are monitored closely at every stage, and follow-up continues after discharge with the involvement of social support teams.
docs_extra: Haematology and pathology reports, including bone marrow biopsy results
Details of previous chemotherapy or other treatment received

algology.title: Algology (Pain Medicine)
algology.lead: Algology, or pain medicine, focuses on identifying the source of chronic pain and building a treatment plan around the individual, including pain whose cause is difficult to pin down. At our partner hospital, a pain specialist examines each patient in detail before recommending options, which may combine medical, interventional and lifestyle measures. MedLuxLife arranges the consultation, shares your records in advance and coordinates any follow-up.
cards: Chronic pain treatment
Assessment and personalised management of long-standing pain, with the aim of finding its underlying cause.
Interventional pain treatment
Image-guided and needle-based procedures that target the structures thought to be generating pain.
Cancer pain management
Pain control tailored to people living with cancer, coordinated with their wider treatment.
Acupuncture (dry needling)
A needle-based therapy that may be used alongside other approaches to help relieve muscular and chronic pain.
Ozone therapy
Medical ozone treatment, including autohaemotherapy, offered as part of selected pain treatment plans.
Epiduroscopy
A minimally invasive endoscopic examination of the epidural space that can be used in the assessment and treatment of certain back and leg pain.
Epidural steroid injection
Injection of medication into the epidural space, which may help reduce inflammation-related spinal and radiating pain.
Regional and sympathetic nerve blocks
Targeted injections that interrupt pain signals along specific nerves or the sympathetic nervous system, which may provide longer-term relief in suitable patients.
Radiofrequency thermocoagulation
Controlled heat delivered by radio waves to selected nerves to reduce the transmission of pain.
docs_extra: Recent spinal or joint imaging (MRI, CT) with reports
A list of pain medication currently taken and previous pain treatments

anesthesiology-and-reanimation.title: Anaesthesiology and Reanimation
anesthesiology-and-reanimation.lead: Anaesthesiology and reanimation keeps patients comfortable and free from pain while carefully protecting vital functions during surgery and other procedures. The department at our partner hospital provides anaesthesia, intensive care and pain management, supporting safe treatment and a smoother recovery. MedLuxLife ensures your anaesthetic history and current medication are shared with the team before any planned procedure.
cards: Anaesthesia services
Anaesthesia for surgery and interventional procedures, delivered with modern equipment and continuous monitoring of vital signs.
Supervised recovery
Patients wake up in dedicated recovery areas within the operating suite under the close watch of a physician and an anaesthesia technician.
General intensive care unit
Specialist physicians and nurses care for critically ill adults using mechanical ventilators, cardiac and respiratory monitors, infusion pumps and bedside laboratory testing.
Cardiovascular surgery intensive care
A dedicated unit for patients recovering after heart and major vascular surgery.
Neonatal intensive care
Intensive care for newborn babies who need close monitoring and support.
Isolation rooms
Rooms with adjustable pressure, temperature and humidity for patients with weakened immunity, for example during sepsis or chemotherapy.
Supportive intensive care equipment

Includes beds that reposition patients automatically and provide percussion massage to help prevent pressure sores, individual heating and cooling devices, nutrition pumps, bedside weighing for fluid balance and patient lifts for safe mobilisation.
Pain treatment
A pain clinic that treats post-operative and disease-related pain in collaboration with neurology, psychiatry, oncology, orthopaedics and physical therapy and rehabilitation.
docs_extra: Records of any previous anaesthesia and reactions to it
A list of current medication, including blood thinners

applications-nuclear-medicine.title: Nuclear Medicine
applications-nuclear-medicine.lead: Nuclear medicine uses small amounts of radioactive substances to image and treat disease at a molecular level, giving information about how organs function as well as how they look. The department at our partner hospital works with many specialties, including cardiology, nephrology, orthopaedics, oncology and endocrinology, and has been designed to keep radiation exposure for patients and staff to a minimum. MedLuxLife coordinates referrals, scan appointments and the transfer of results to your treating doctors.
cards: Neurological applications
Scans that can support the diagnosis of certain strokes, dementia and hydrocephalus, and help locate the seizure focus before epilepsy surgery.
Lung applications
Imaging to investigate pulmonary embolism and to estimate remaining lung function before lung surgery.
Orthopaedic applications
Bone imaging to reveal hidden fractures, bone infection and bone metastases.
Heart applications
Studies to assess coronary artery disease and to evaluate the heart after bypass surgery or stenting.
Kidney applications
Imaging to look for urinary tract obstruction, urine reflux towards the kidneys and kidney infection, and to support kidney transplantation.
Oncology applications
Scans that help distinguish benign from malignant lesions, stage tumours, guide biopsy sites, detect recurrence, assess response to chemotherapy and plan radiotherapy.
Other diagnostic studies
Investigations of goitre, oesophageal, stomach and gallbladder disease, acute intestinal bleeding, hidden infection, lymphatic drainage, tear ducts and salivary gland function.
Patient-focused design
Spacious rooms, zoned layout according to radiation levels and daylight-style lighting in treatment rooms are intended to support comfort and safety.
list: Locating the epileptic focus before epilepsy surgery
Assessment of lung reserve before lung surgery
Evaluation after bypass surgery or stent placement
Investigating urine reflux to the kidneys
docs_extra: Previous scan images on CD or via download link, with reports
Recent kidney function and, where relevant, thyroid blood test results

audiology.title: Audiology
audiology.lead: Audiology covers the detailed assessment and rehabilitation of hearing and balance problems in babies, children and adults. The department at our partner hospital offers a broad range of hearing and vestibular tests, including objective tests suitable for infants and for people with dizziness. MedLuxLife helps families schedule tests at suitable times, explains preparation requirements in advance and arranges for results to be shared with your doctors at home.
cards: Newborn hearing screening
Screening of babies' hearing using BERA so that possible hearing loss can be identified early.
Clinical BERA (ABR)

An objective electrophysiological test that measures the auditory nerve's response to sound through electrodes placed on the head, used especially for infants who did not pass screening, babies with risk factors and children with speech delay who cannot complete other tests. It is also known as ABR, BAEP or BAER.
Clinical otoacoustic emissions and ASSR
TEOAE/DPOAE and auditory steady-state response testing, which can support and complement BERA findings.
Child audiometry
Age-appropriate hearing tests including behavioural observation audiometry, visual reinforcement audiometry and play audiometry, as well as free field testing.
Adult hearing evaluation
Pure-tone and speech audiometry, plus high-frequency audiometry where indicated.
Middle ear and Eustachian tube tests
Tympanometry and acoustic reflex testing, high-frequency (1000 Hz) tympanometry for babies up to six months, and Eustachian tube function testing.
Videonystagmography (VNG)
Records eye movements with video goggles during oculomotor, positional and caloric tests to help determine whether dizziness originates in the inner ear or the brain.
Video head impulse test (vHIT)
Assesses the vestibulo-ocular reflex of each semicircular canal separately.
VEMP test
Vestibular evoked myogenic potentials, used in the differential diagnosis of conditions such as semicircular canal dehiscence, early Meniere's disease and otolith organ dysfunction.
Caloric and rotational testing
Caloric vestibular testing (ENG) and rotational examination to evaluate the function of each balance organ and central compensation.
Repositioning manoeuvres for BPPV
When benign paroxysmal positional vertigo is identified, corrective manoeuvres such as Epley, Vannucchi, Gufoni and BBQ roll may be performed.
Preparing a child for BERA

The test is usually done during natural sleep without medication, so babies are brought awake and fasted for feeding and sleep at the clinic; evening appointments, or testing under general anaesthesia with an anaesthetist at the family's request, may be arranged.
audiology.list_heading: Conditions that tests can help evaluate
list: Hearing loss in babies, children and adults
Speech and language delay with suspected hearing loss
Balance problems after traumatic brain injury

Newborn screening results and birth history for infants

breast-surgery.title: Breast Surgery
breast-surgery.lead: Breast surgery deals with the surgical treatment of breast diseases, most notably breast cancer, where early diagnosis can make a meaningful difference to treatment options. At our partner hospital, breast surgeons work alongside medical oncology, plastic surgery, radiology and pathology so that each plan reflects the individual's diagnosis and preferences. MedLuxLife helps you gather your imaging and biopsy results and arranges a multidisciplinary opinion before any decision is made.
cards: Multidisciplinary breast care
Diagnosis and treatment planning involve breast surgery, medical oncology, plastic surgery, radiology, pathology and other specialists as needed.
Lumpectomy (breast-conserving surgery)
Removal of the tumour together with a small margin of surrounding healthy tissue, preserving the rest of the breast.
Total mastectomy
Removal of the entire breast, which may be considered in early- or later-stage breast cancer depending on the individual situation.
Nipple-sparing mastectomy
Removal of breast tissue while preserving the skin and nipple, usually combined with an implant to restore breast shape.
Prophylactic mastectomy
Preventive removal of breast tissue that may be discussed with people at high risk of breast cancer to help reduce that risk.
Individual choice of technique
The surgical approach is selected according to the stage of disease, the patient's condition and their wishes.
docs_extra: Mammography, breast ultrasound and MRI images with reports
Biopsy and pathology reports, including receptor status if available

cardiovascular-surgery.title: Cardiovascular Surgery
cardiovascular-surgery.lead: Cardiovascular surgery treats diseases of the heart and major blood vessels, from coronary artery disease and valve problems to congenital heart defects and aortic disease. The department at our partner hospital offers surgery for both adults and children, with dedicated intensive care and a sterile operating environment. MedLuxLife arranges a review of your cardiac tests by the surgical team before travel, so you understand the proposed approach in advance.
cards: Coronary bypass surgery
Conventional bypass surgery and beating-heart bypass surgery for narrowed coronary arteries.
Heart valve surgery
Repair or prosthetic replacement of the aortic, mitral and tricuspid valves.
Congenital heart defects
Surgical repair in children and adults, including ASD, VSD, PDA, aortic coarctation, Ebstein's anomaly, tetralogy of Fallot and transposition of the great arteries (TGA).
Aortic surgery
Surgery for aortic aneurysms of the ascending aorta, arch and descending aorta, including combined procedures, and for acute and chronic aortic dissection.
Peripheral vascular surgery
Surgical treatment of diseases affecting the arteries and veins outside the heart.
Heart failure surgery
Heart transplantation, artificial heart pumps and anti-remodelling surgery for advanced heart failure.
Pericardiectomy
Removal of the pericardium, the sac around the heart, when it restricts heart function.
Heart tumour surgery
Surgical removal of tumours of the heart.
Reoperative cardiac surgery
Second and third operations for patients who have had previous heart or vascular surgery.
docs_extra: Echocardiography, ECG and coronary angiography reports and images
Operation notes from any previous heart surgery

chest-diseases.title: Chest Diseases (Pulmonology)
chest-diseases.lead: Chest diseases, or pulmonology, covers the diagnosis, treatment and long-term follow-up of conditions affecting the lungs and airways. The department at our partner hospital serves adult patients through its outpatient clinic, bronchoscopy unit, pulmonary function laboratory and allergy skin testing. MedLuxLife coordinates appointments and ensures that your previous scans and lung function results reach the specialist before you arrive.
cards: Outpatient clinic
Assessment, diagnosis and individual treatment planning for adults with respiratory symptoms or known lung disease.
Bronchoscopy unit
Examination of the airways with a flexible camera to support diagnosis and, where needed, treatment.
Pulmonary function laboratory
Breathing tests that measure how well the lungs are working.
Allergy skin testing
Skin tests that can help identify allergic triggers for respiratory symptoms.
Smoking cessation support
Counselling and follow-up for people who want to stop smoking.
Respiratory physiotherapy
Breathing physiotherapy for hospitalised patients.
Medical treatment and follow-up
Ongoing physician follow-up and adjustment of treatment for chronic lung conditions.
list: Lung disease caused by occupational exposure
docs_extra: Chest X-ray or CT images with reports
Previous lung function (spirometry) results

child-and-adolescent-psychiatry.title: Child and Adolescent Psychiatry
child-and-adolescent-psychiatry.lead: Childhood and adolescence are times of rapid physical, emotional and psychological change, and mental health concerns in these years need an assessment that takes development and family circumstances into account. The child and adolescent psychiatry department at our partner hospital offers assessment, follow-up and treatment programmes for emotional, behavioural and developmental difficulties. MedLuxLife helps families arrange consultations, share school and medical reports and plan follow-up across borders.
cards: Comprehensive assessment
Evaluation of a child's mental, emotional and behavioural health in the context of their developmental stage and environment.
Diagnosis and treatment planning
Structured diagnosis and an individual treatment plan for disorders arising in childhood and adolescence.
Family and relationship support
Attention to mother-baby-child relationships, sibling rivalry and parent-teenager conflict.
Long-term follow-up
Ongoing monitoring of mental development, including for children with chronic illnesses and their families.
list: Autism and related pervasive developmental disorders
Depression and anxiety disorders in children and adolescents
Feeding and sleeping problems in infancy and the preschool years
Intellectual disability and related behavioural problems
Children and adolescents prone to violence
Mental health concerns in children and adolescents with chronic illnesses, and their families
docs_extra: Previous psychological or developmental assessment reports
Relevant school reports or teacher observations

dermatology.title: Dermatology
dermatology.lead: Dermatology covers the diagnosis, treatment and follow-up of conditions affecting the skin, hair and nails. Alongside medical dermatology, the department at our partner hospital offers dermatosurgery, cosmetic dermatology and care for certain genital skin conditions. MedLuxLife arranges consultations and helps combine dermatology appointments with any other treatment you are planning during your stay.
cards: Medical dermatology
Diagnosis, treatment and follow-up of a wide range of skin, hair and nail diseases.
Dermatosurgery
Surgical procedures on the skin, for example for moles or skin lesions that need removal or examination.
Cosmetic dermatology
Dermatocosmetic procedures including laser applications, botulinum toxin (Botox) and chemical peels.
Genital skin conditions
Diagnosis and treatment of genital warts, molluscum, genital herpes, external genital fungal infections and syphilis.
Skin cancer and mole assessment
Examination of moles and suspicious lesions, and treatment planning for skin cancers.
docs_extra: Photographs showing how the skin condition has changed over time
Previous skin biopsy or pathology reports

emergency-medicine.title: Emergency Medicine
emergency-medicine.lead: Emergency medicine provides rapid assessment and treatment of sudden illness, injury and life-threatening conditions in adults and children. The emergency department at our partner hospital is open 24 hours a day and is supervised by emergency medicine specialists, with imaging and laboratory support close at hand. For MedLuxLife patients already in treatment, we can help with communication and coordination if urgent care is needed during your stay.
cards: 24-hour emergency care
Round-the-clock care for adult and paediatric patients with acute illness or injury, led by emergency medicine specialists.
Resuscitation room
A dedicated area equipped for cardiopulmonary resuscitation (CPR).
Trauma room
A room set up for the assessment and initial treatment of injured patients.
Monitored observation beds
Beds with continuous monitoring for evaluating and observing emergency patients.
Imaging and laboratory support
Rapid access to imaging and laboratory testing to support fast diagnosis.
Ambulance service
Hospital ambulance services are available for emergency transfers.
list: Protection against preventable death and permanent disability

endocrine-surgery.title: Endocrine Surgery
endocrine-surgery.lead: Endocrine surgery treats disorders of the hormone-producing glands, mainly the thyroid, parathyroid and adrenal glands, when too much or too little hormone is produced or when a growth needs removal. These delicate operations require careful technique to protect the voice, calcium balance and surrounding structures. MedLuxLife helps you share your hormone results and scans with the surgical team at our partner hospital and plan your stay around surgery and recovery.
cards: Thyroidectomy
Removal of the whole thyroid gland or one of its lobes, for example for nodules, goitre, overactivity or cancer.
Parathyroidectomy
Removal of one or more of the four parathyroid glands, which regulate calcium and phosphorus levels.
Parathyroid transplantation
Reimplantation of parathyroid tissue, which may be performed to preserve calcium regulation.
Adrenalectomy
Removal of one or both adrenal glands, which produce cortisol and hormones involved in blood pressure control and development.
Pancreatectomy
Removal of part or all of the pancreas, for example for neuroendocrine tumours.
Specialised surgical expertise
Operations are carried out by surgeons with additional experience in endocrine surgery, with a focus on careful, precise technique.
docs_extra: Thyroid, parathyroid or adrenal hormone and calcium blood test results
Neck ultrasound, scintigraphy or CT/MRI reports, and any fine-needle biopsy results

endocrinology-and-metabolism-diseases.title: Endocrinology and Metabolic Diseases
endocrinology-and-metabolism-diseases.lead: Endocrinology deals with the hormone-producing glands and the metabolic conditions they influence, such as diabetes, thyroid disorders and diseases of the pituitary and adrenal glands. Most of these conditions are diagnosed with blood tests and imaging and treated with medication and lifestyle measures, with long-term follow-up. MedLuxLife arranges a consultation with an endocrinologist at our partner hospital and coordinates any further tests or treatment.
cards: Diabetes
Diagnosis, treatment and follow-up of type 1 and type 2 diabetes, including insulin therapy, modern oral and injectable medicines and screening for complications.
Thyroid disorders
Treatment of an underactive or overactive thyroid (hypothyroidism, hyperthyroidism), Hashimoto's and Graves' disease, and assessment of thyroid nodules.
Pituitary diseases
Diagnosis and treatment of pituitary tumours and hormone imbalances, in cooperation with the pituitary clinic and neurosurgery.
Adrenal diseases
Assessment of adrenal gland disorders such as Cushing's syndrome, Addison's disease, hyperaldosteronism and adrenal masses.
Calcium, bone and parathyroid
Diagnosis and treatment of osteoporosis, vitamin D deficiency and parathyroid hormone disorders.
Obesity and metabolic syndrome
Medical assessment of weight-related metabolic problems, insulin resistance and metabolic syndrome, with referral to nutrition or obesity surgery where suitable.
Lipid disorders
Diagnosis and treatment of high cholesterol and triglyceride levels to reduce cardiovascular risk.
Reproductive hormones
Hormonal causes of irregular periods, hirsutism, PCOS, low testosterone and menopause-related complaints.
list: Dynamic hormone stimulation and suppression tests
Oral glucose tolerance test and HbA1c
Fine-needle aspiration biopsy of thyroid nodules
Imaging of the pituitary and adrenal glands in cooperation with radiology
docs_extra: Recent hormone test results (for example thyroid tests, HbA1c)
Your current insulin or hormone doses

gastroenterological-surgery.title: Gastroenterological Surgery
gastroenterological-surgery.lead: Gastroenterological surgery is the surgical specialty for diseases of the digestive tract, from the mouth to the anus, when medication or endoscopic treatment is not enough. At our partner hospital, surgeons with subspecialty training in this field work closely with gastroenterologists on diagnosis and treatment planning. MedLuxLife coordinates the review of your endoscopy, imaging and pathology results so that a surgical opinion can be given before you travel.
cards: Oesophageal, stomach and intestinal cancers
Surgical treatment of cancers affecting the oesophagus, stomach and intestines.
Liver and biliary tract surgery
Surgery for conditions of the liver and bile ducts that require an operation.
Pancreas and spleen surgery
Surgical care for diseases of the pancreas and spleen.
Intra-abdominal conditions
Surgical treatment of other diseases of the abdominal structures and digestive system that need surgical intervention.
Close work with gastroenterology
Gastroenterology handles diagnosis and endoscopic procedures, while the surgical team takes over when an operation is needed, supporting a joined-up plan.
docs_extra: Endoscopy and colonoscopy reports with pathology results
Abdominal CT or MRI images with reports

gastroenterology.title: Gastroenterology
gastroenterology.lead: Gastroenterology covers the evaluation, diagnosis and treatment of diseases of the stomach, intestines, liver, bile ducts and pancreas. The department at our partner hospital offers a wide range of diagnostic and therapeutic endoscopy, alongside dedicated care for reflux, liver disease, inflammatory bowel disease and colorectal cancer screening. MedLuxLife helps you arrange procedures, understand preparation instructions and receive your reports in a form your home doctor can use.
cards: Diagnostic endoscopy

Upper gastrointestinal endoscopy, colonoscopy and double-balloon endoscopy (enteroscopy), which can examine parts of the small intestine beyond the reach of standard scopes, for example in unexplained bleeding, iron-deficiency anaemia or suspected Crohn's disease.
Endoscopic treatment of bleeding
Band ligation, sclerotherapy, haemoclips and argon laser treatment for bleeding from the stomach or intestines.
Treatment of narrowing
Balloon dilatation and stent placement for strictures of the stomach or intestines.
Endoscopic obesity treatment
Intragastric balloon placement during upper endoscopy, which may support weight loss alongside lifestyle changes; the balloon is removed after a set period.
Reflux diagnosis and treatment

Upper endoscopy, 24-hour pH monitoring and motility studies, followed by medication, endoscopic options such as the Stretta procedure and endoscopic fundoplication (for example Plicator or Gastrofix), or surgery.
Helicobacter pylori testing
Urea breath test and stool antigen testing to diagnose H. pylori infection and guide treatment.
Colorectal cancer screening
Screening colonoscopy with polypectomy, as polyps can be found and removed during the procedure; people at higher risk receive an individual screening plan.
ERCP
Endoscopic imaging of the bile and pancreatic ducts, which also allows stone removal, stent placement to relieve blockages and biopsy.
Haemorrhoid treatment
Medication for early stages and band ligation, sclerotherapy, laser or infrared treatment during sedated colonoscopy for intermediate stages, with referral for surgery in advanced cases.
Hepatology unit

Diagnosis and long-term follow-up of chronic hepatitis B and C using liver function tests, HBV and HCV PCR, abdominal ultrasound and liver biopsy, with antiviral treatment options including interferon.
Inflammatory bowel disease
Diagnosis of ulcerative colitis and Crohn's disease by colonoscopy and/or double-balloon enteroscopy, and ongoing medical treatment.
docs_extra: Previous endoscopy or colonoscopy reports with pathology results
Recent liver function and hepatitis test results, if relevant

general-surgery.title: General Surgery
general-surgery.lead: General surgery covers the evaluation and operative treatment of a broad range of conditions affecting the digestive tract, abdominal organs, breast, endocrine glands and soft tissues. The general surgery team at our partner hospital uses modern techniques, including laparoscopic (keyhole) surgery where suitable. MedLuxLife coordinates a surgical review of your records before travel and supports you through admission, recovery and the journey home.
cards: Upper digestive tract surgery
Surgery of the oesophagus and stomach.
Intestinal and anal surgery
Operations for intestinal diseases and conditions of the anal region, including haemorrhoids and pilonidal sinus.
Liver, biliary, pancreas and spleen surgery
Surgical treatment of conditions affecting the liver, bile ducts, pancreas and spleen.
Hernia surgery
Repair of abdominal wall and groin hernias, using laparoscopic techniques where suitable.
Morbid obesity surgery
Surgical treatment options for severe obesity.
Breast surgery
Surgical treatment of breast diseases.
Endocrine surgery
Operations on the thyroid and adrenal glands.
Soft tissue tumours
Surgical removal of tumours in the soft tissues.
Vascular access for dialysis
Creation of an arteriovenous (A-V) fistula or shunt for patients who need haemodialysis.
Laparoscopic surgery
Minimally invasive keyhole techniques applied across a wide range of general surgical procedures.
docs_extra: Ultrasound, CT or MRI reports relevant to the planned surgery
